channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Moment Ukrainian drones strike Russia’s Belgorod
item.description: Dramatic videos captured the moment Ukrainian drones hit Belgorod, a Russian city near the Ukrainian border.

item.title: Why has the US halted its bombing of Iran?
item.description: Tit-for-tat strikes have halted in the Middle East amid reports of depleted US weapons stocks.

item.title: Iran warns Ukraine of retaliation after deadly Caspian Sea strike
item.description: Abbas Araghchi says the Ukrainian attack on the Iranian vessel in the Caspian Sea 'cannot go unanswered'.

item.title: Oil price dives as US and Iran pause attacks
item.description: The US says attacks on Iran have been halted to give "talks some space", raising hopes of a resolution to the conflict.

item.title: Berlin Pride attack suspect shot and killed during police operation
item.description: Police say Abdul Ballout was shot and killed after he rushed at officers with a knife in a western borough of Berlin.

item.title: Israeli settlers set fire to mosques, cars and farm land in West Bank, Palestinians say
item.description: The latest attacks come two days after a clash between settlers and Palestinians near the village of Tal, which left four Palestinians and two Israelis dead.
